points.text: NVIDIA introduced an open software platform and reference design intended to enforce security boundaries around AI agents, with safeguards from testing through deployment.

Authorities urged organizations to address Citrix NetScaler vulnerabilities, including two critical flaws reported to be actively exploited and potentially enabling unauthenticated remote code execution.
SpaceX’s Starship reached orbit for the first time on its 14th test flight, which ended earlier than planned with the spacecraft returning to Earth.
The Trump administration set a fleet-average fuel-economy requirement of 34.9 miles per gallon, down from the previous 50.4 mpg standard, and said the change will reduce vehicle prices.
